- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Two types declare a method named `RunOnce`, both named `Runner` but in different packages:

**`*s3presign.Runner` — invoked? YES — two production callers**
- Declared at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` (`func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context)`)
- Caller 1: `server/server.go:163`, inside `(*Server).startBackgroundRunners` — a one-shot presign pass at startup, before the ticker loop goroutine is launched. That method is reached from `server/server.go:129` (`Server.Start`).
- Caller 2: `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`, inside `(*Runner).Run` — invoked on each tick of the 12-hour ticker.

**`*memopayload.Runner` — invoked? NO — no caller (production or test)**
- Declared at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` (`// RunOnce rebuilds the payload of all memos.`)
- Nothing calls it. `memopayload.NewRunner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19`) has no callers either, so the `Runner` type is never constructed. The only live use of the `memopayload` package is the free function `RebuildMemoPayload`, called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447` — not through the `Runner` type.
